purpose: One segment of a ButtonGroup: a selectable action with no radius or edge of its own, because the group clips the corners and draws the shared edge.

notFor.case: A single action on its own.

Default.visual: Fill of the group's Variant: Action/primary/default with Content/on-action, Action/secondary/default with Content/on-secondary, Surface/inverse with Content/inverse, or no fill with Content/primary (outline).

Hover.visual: Fill moves to Action/primary/hover, Action/secondary/hover or Action/ghost/hover; inverse gains a Surface/inverse-muted overlay.

Pressed.visual: Fill moves to Action/primary/pressed, Action/secondary/pressed or Action/ghost/pressed; inverse gains a Surface/inverse-muted overlay.

Focused.visual: A 2px ring inside the segment: Border/ring/default, Border/subtle or Surface/inverse-muted by Variant.

Disabled.visual: Surface/page under an Action/disabled/default overlay, Content/disabled ink.

Active=true.visual: Pinned to the pressed fill (Action/primary/pressed, Action/secondary/pressed) or, for outline, Surface/selected with Content/accent.

Active=false.visual: The fill of the current State.

a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches it; Enter or Space activates it (native button).
notes: Icon-only segments always need an aria-label.
Loading shows a spinner after the label and sets aria-busy.
The contract lists no motion roles for the segment.

openQuestions: Motion: the contract declares no motion for the segment's hover and press. Should it move on use-hover like Button?
Loading: the Figma set has LoadingVisible as a property, not a State. Is a loading segment also blocked from clicks?
